name: Yorihime Nao
source:
Beautiful, intellectual and an amazing swimmer, Nao has an open attraction towards [url=/c552]Haruka[/url]. As a close and trusted childhood friend, Nao was sincerely devastated when it seemed she would never see the two siblings again. Nao’s compassion and maturity projects an ambiance of sisterly love onto others, though for Haruka there is an intimately deeper and sensual emotion. [url=/c553]Sora[/url] harbors great resentment towards the popular student, never taking an effort to explain the reasons why.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150331123620/http://www.erogereview.com/2009/02/16/yosuga-no-sora/]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
